## Structured fields

Schemas for the data organization and access protocols of a data storage. These fields hold rows validated against a published schema; the form shows them as a table, the API returns them as stored. The fields of each row:

### Data organization

Define the hierarchical organization of the data in this data storage, from top-level to most specific. Example: Projects → Subjects → Sessions.

This type has no type-specific fields. The record's own fields and its material rows describe it.

### Data protocols

Define the available protocols for accessing this data storage. Each protocol specifies how users can connect to and retrieve data from the storage system. On your local system, you can further define a separate set of local access protocols if applicable.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Protocol Type` | **Required.** Choice. Options: Globus, HTTPS/Web, SFTP, FTP, SMB/CIFS, NFS, AFP, S3, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Local Storage, Other. |
| `Access Path/URL` | **Required.** Text. |
| `Public Access` | Yes/no. |

The schemas are published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/DataStorage/` (see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/)); the API view with property codes is on the [DataStorage API page](/api/personal_attributes/datastorage/#json-field-schemas).
